title: A campaign's chat (saves/<campaign>/chat.json)
description: The chat, oldest first: Claude's narration, rulings and NPC lines, and roll cards: initiative, check and damage cards (board/chat.js). Table events were retired on 2026-11-12 (they go to the audit log); old ones still load. Change-log lines (kind 'log', retired 2026-11-12) are read into the audit log (audit.schema.json). On the board each message is a record chat/<id>.

kind.description: check, damage: roll cards (their roll, rolls, applied: board/rolldetail.js entries); event: retired 2026-11-12, old ones still show; log: retired; read into the audit log
